answer: Each identity locks 20 POA in a shared vault, grouped by funding source into one atlas of clusters. Every epoch a random 10% of identities face a deep audit; if one member of a cluster is caught as fake, the whole cluster's escrow burns - 100 fakes lose all 2,000 POA at once. With 100 fakes audited at 10% each, the chance at least one is caught tops 99.9%, so the expected loss per fake is nearly its full bond, while an honest identity passes its violet audit for free.
